title: Shalzaru's Lair
wikitext:
[[File:Shalzaru's Lair.jpg|thumb|Shalzaru's Lair]]

A large, twisting [[naga]] lair south of [[Feathermoon Stronghold]]'s island at the northern end of the [[Isle of Dread]].  The master of the [[Hatecrest]], [[Shalzaru]], dwells deep inside.

The cave consists of a main cave and a smaller cave. They are connected by a waterway. The cave is filled with [[Hatecrest Sorceress]]es and [[Hatecrest Serpent Guard]]s.

* [[File:WoWlogo.png|40px]] '''Patch 1.4.0 (2005-04-19):''' Shalzaru's Lair on the Isle of Dread off the coast of Feralas now properly displays its name when you enter the cave.
